source_row.extraction_instructions: Server-rendered calendar shows one year at a time as date_row rows (dates, title link, location); the extractor reads the current view plus the next two /date/<YYYY>/ pages. Rows are BMFMS, RCOG and third-party meetings. Detail pages are thin (date, place, prose); fees are on the external organiser site linked from 'Further details' / 'Book online'.

registry_comment: BMFMS (maternal & fetal medicine) events calendar: year-view date_row rows, current + next 2 year pages; fees on external organiser sites

spot_check.site_says: Tickets are £10, charged as a donation to St George's

concerns: Recon's '?page=' pagination does not exist: the site shows one year at a time; the extractor reads the current view plus the next two /date/<YYYY>/ pages (3 requests).

Fees live on external organiser sites linked from 'Further details' / 'Book online' (stored as organiser_url, PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK in --coverage). Tiers only where the BMFMS page itself states a fee (Perinatal Symposium £10; webinar series 'free webinars for members'). Members' fees behind login are not recorded.
The recurring 'BMFMS Webinar series' reuses one URL for several dates: each date is a separate row via a '#<date>' fragment on booking_url/source_url.
Two rows titled 'Recognising & Responding to Maternal Deterioration' share a date (10 Dec, one virtual with a time, one without); only the first is kept (title+date dedupe).
Addresses with a street but no town ('..., Blackshaw Road, SW17 0QT') leave city null (self-healing re-fetch) instead of a wrong city.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges (end_date) checked against the page on every source; no fee-table images were seen on the tested pages; SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT warnings from the harness --coverage run were false positives (related-event lists / unrelated '4 days' wording on the same page).
remediator.audit not run (needs the database); harness --coverage was run instead.
